t: Magnusson fine 120 grit hand sanding sheets are designed for manual material removal on wood and metal surfaces. The versatile sheets are ideal for decorators and trade professionals preparing surfaces for priming or painting. Featuring sharp silicon carbide abrasive on a durable B-weight waterproof latex paper backing, they ensure a long-lasting and aggressive cutting action. This heavy-duty design makes them suitable for both wet and dry applications, ensuring maximum coverage and a consistent finish.
b: 230 x 280mm Sheets Provide Wide Surface Coverage
Durable Build Prevents Premature Clogging & Wear
Flexible Sheets Conform to Curved Surfaces
